grids.native: Original palette-label grid, raw d=q/255 float64, K*abs(d-original focus). No resize before abs.
grids.actual_condition: Unchanged author WholeVid loader. Observe actual CoC immediately BEFORE its inplace Normalize (after Resize bilinear antialias+CenterCrop), first RGB-channel timesK. No inverse-normalization or resize(d)-then-abs substitution. Verify all real overlap copies. CPU only.

regions: For each original nonzero ID separately, plus independent ID!=0 union: whole/interior/boundary. Labels nearest at1024x576; interior erode7x7 square, radius3 display pixels, border0. Native interior = original native ID/union intersect nearest-upsampled corresponding DISPLAY interior; boundary = original native mask minus interior. This defines the same3-display-pixel exclusion in two grids; projection differences disclosed.
empty: Zero pixels => null metrics, retain rows. ID union across25 defines expected IDs; clip median/max over valid frames with count; no silent deletion.
aggregation: Median of the25 per-frame metrics, not pooled pixels or median of ID medians. Highest frame for each metric, earliest index on ties. No correlation/significance with about6 user annotations.
primary_ranking: actual_condition / union / interior / per-frame fraction(K*CoC>1) clip median descending; ties scene_id ascending. Fixed before statistics. Native-grid ranking reported separately, not substituted after seeing order.
selection_exclusion: All DAVIS entries in both B manifests/B1/B2; original six-method fixed8 preflight list; all existing scene-specific review HTML metadata under existing failure-analysis root; explicit B19/B21/B33/B24/B28. Metadata inventory only, not model images/metrics. Statistical sample highest eligible exploration scene; not blind test.
